desc:
Your magic is waiting. ✨

Spin for your spellbook. Level it. Awaken it. Rise from rookie to legend.

📖 SPELLBOOKS - 15 books in four tiers, from Fire and Water to rare Mythicals. Lv 10 and Lv 20 unlock new spells.

⚡ AWAKENING - Hunt Spell Pages from bosses. Every awakening sharpens damage and crit. The fifth unlocks your ultimate.

🐉 WORLD BOSSES - A new boss rises every 90 minutes. Team up and split the loot.

🎉 SERVER EVENTS - 2x Luck or +20% XP every 2 hours, every hour on weekends.

⚔️ COMBAT - Real-time combos and dodges. Fight in the PvP Arena and raise your bounty.

🏝️ WORLD - 12 islands of monsters, island bosses, broom races and a dungeon below.

🛡️ SQUADS - Build a squad, chat together and join squadmates' servers.

🏅 RANKS - Climb 17 ranks for auras and stat buffs.

🎣 MORE - Fishing, mining, races, brooms, trading, daily deals, AFK rewards and a Forge for cosmetics.

Will you take the crown, or watch someone else wear it?

Join the Discord for codes!
